article.title: Do subjective and objective baseline sleep disturbances predict post-traumatic stress disorder treatment response? A secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial.
article.authors: Porten S, Friedmann F, Schoofs N
article.abstract: Sleep disturbances did not predict PTSD treatment outcomes.Depression did not moderate the link between sleep and PTSD treatment success.Findings were consistent across subjective and objective sleep assessments.
